sentences: In August 1888, in the Yellow House at Arles in the south of France, Van Gogh painted sunflowers to decorate the room where his fellow painter Gauguin would soon stay.
The vase holds fifteen blooms covering a whole life cycle: a tight bud, flowers in full glow, and heads that have dropped their petals and gone to seed.
Background, table and vase are nearly all yellow, and Van Gogh himself called it a picture all in yellow.
The flower heads are built up in paint so thick they seem to rise off the canvas.
On the vase he signed simply "Vincent" in blue.
That December the two artists quarrelled badly, and their life together ended after just two months.
